name: search_issues
title: Search issues
description: Searches Jira issues with a JQL query and returns, for each match, its key, summary, status, type, priority, assignee and last update, most recently updated first unless the query has an ORDER BY. Example: project = OPS AND status != Done ORDER BY updated DESC.

jql.description: JQL query, e.g. project = OPS AND text ~ "timeout".

name: get_issue
title: Get issue
description: Returns one Jira issue: summary, status, type, priority, assignee, reporter, dates, description and its last comments. Long texts are shortened.

key.description: Issue key: project key, dash, number, e.g. OPS-123.

name: add_comment
title: Add comment
description: Adds a comment to a Jira issue, as the connected user. The text is posted as is (Jira wiki markup). Returns the id and date of the new comment.

key.description: Issue key: project key, dash, number, e.g. OPS-123.
